			end
		end
	end

    if param.target ~= self:GetParent() then return end
    -- if param.damage_category ~= DOTA_DAMAGE_CATEGORY_SPELL then return end
    local hModifer = param.attacker:FindModifierByName("m_modifier_axe_counter_helix_damage_reduction")

    if hModifer then
        reduceDamage = math.min(

    end
    return -reduceDamage

    local parent = self:GetParent()

    end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if IsServer() then
        self.duration = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
        parent:AddNewModifier(parent, self:GetAbility(), 'modifier_batrider_firefly', {duration = self.duration})
        self:StartIntervalThink(self.duration)
    end

    if IsServer() then
        local parent = self:GetParent()
        local modifier = parent:FindModifierByName('modifier_batrider_firefly')
        if parent:IsAlive() then
            if modifier then
                modifier:Destroy()
            end
            parent:AddNewModifier(parent, self:GetAbility(), 'modifier_batrider_firefly', {duration = self.duration})
        end
    end

    if self:GetParent() ~= params.unit then return end
    self:ForceRefresh()

function dark_willow_bedlam:OnSpellStart()
	-- unit identifier
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	local duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "roaming_duration" )

    local count = 1
    if GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty() > 1 then
        count = 3
    end

    for i = 1, count do
        caster:AddNewModifier(
            caster,                                                               -- player source
            self,                                                                 -- ability source
            "modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua",                                    -- modifier name
            { duration = duration, add_rotation = i * 120 - 120, cast_index = i } -- kv
        )
    end
	if count > 1 then
		for i = 1, 6 do
			caster:AddNewModifier(
				caster,                                                  -- player source
				self,                                                    -- ability source
				"modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua",                       -- modifier name
				{ duration = duration, add_rotation = i * 60 - 150, cast_index = i + 3, rs = 2 } -- kv
			)
		end
	end
end

	return false

	return false

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:GetAttributes()
	return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Initializations
function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:OnCreated( kv )
	self.parent = self:GetParent()
	self.zero = Vector(0,0,0)

	-- references
	self.revolution = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor( "roaming_seconds_per_rotation" )
	self.rotate_radius = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor( "roaming_radius" )

	if not IsServer() then return end

	self.cast_index = kv.cast_index

	if kv.rs then
		self.rotate_radius = self.rotate_radius  * kv.rs
	end
	
	-- init data
	self.interval = 0.03
	self.base_facing = Vector(0,1,0)
	self.relative_pos = Vector( -self.rotate_radius, 0, 100 )
	self.rotate_delta = 360/self.revolution * self.interval

	-- set init location
	self.position = self.parent:GetOrigin() + self.relative_pos
	self.rotation = kv.add_rotation
	self.facing = self.base_facing

	-- create wisp
	self.wisp = CreateUnitByName(
		"npc_dota_dark_willow_creature",
		self.position,
		true,
		self.parent,
		self.parent:GetOwner(),
		self.parent:GetTeamNumber()
	)
	self.wisp:SetForwardVector( self.facing )
	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(
		self:GetCaster(), -- player source
		self:GetAbility(), -- ability source
		"modifier_wisp_ambient", -- modifier name
		{} -- kv
	)

	-- add attack modifier
	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(
		self:GetCaster(), -- player source
		self:GetAbility(), -- ability source
		"modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua_attack", -- modifier name
		{ duration = kv.duration } -- kv
	)

	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(self.wisp,nil,"mz_modifier_invulnerable",{})
	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(self.wisp,nil,"mz_modifier_unselectable",{})

	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(self.wisp,nil,"mz_modifier_no_health_bar",{})
	-- Start interval
	self:StartIntervalThink( self.interval )

	-- deactivate ability
	if self.cast_index == 1 then
		local ability = self:GetCaster():FindAbilityByName( "dark_willow_terrorize" )
		if ability then ability:SetActivated( false ) end
	end

	-- play effects
	self:PlayEffects()
end

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:OnRefresh( kv )
	-- refresh references
	self.revolution = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor( "roaming_seconds_per_rotation" )
	self.rotate_radius = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor( "roaming_radius" )

	if not IsServer() then return end

	self.relative_pos = Vector( -self.rotate_radius, 0, 100 )
	self.rotate_delta = 360/self.revolution * self.interval

	-- refresh attack modifier
	self.wisp:AddNewModifier(
		self:GetCaster(), -- player source
		self:GetAbility(), -- ability source
		"modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua_attack", -- modifier name
		{ duration = kv.duration } -- kv
	)
end

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:OnRemoved()
end

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:OnDestroy()
	if not IsServer() then return end

	-- kill the wisp
	UTIL_Remove( self.wisp )
	-- self.wisp:ForceKill( false )

	-- reactivate ability
	if self.cast_index == 1 then
		local ability = self:GetCaster():FindAbilityByName( "dark_willow_terrorize" )
		if ability then ability:SetActivated( true ) end
	end

end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interval Effects
function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:OnIntervalThink()
	-- update position
	self.rotation = self.rotation + self.rotate_delta
	local origin = self.parent:GetOrigin()
	self.position = RotatePosition( origin, QAngle( 0, -self.rotation, 0 ), origin + self.relative_pos )
	self.facing = RotatePosition( self.zero, QAngle( 0, -self.rotation, 0 ), self.base_facing )

	-- update wisp
	self.wisp:SetOrigin( self.position )
	self.wisp:SetForwardVector( self.facing )
end

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua:PlayEffects()
	-- Get Resources
	local particle_cast = "particles/units/heroes/hero_dark_willow/dark_willow_wisp_aoe_cast.vpcf"

	-- Create Particle
	local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle( particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, self:GetParent() )

	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(
		effect_cast,
		1,
		self:GetParent(),
		PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,
		"attach_hitloc",
		Vector(0,0,0), -- unknown
		true -- unknown, true
	)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(

		2,
		self:GetParent(),
		PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW,
		"attach_hitloc",

	)

	ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex( effect_cast )

function modifier_dark_willow_bedlam_lua_attack:OnIntervalThink()
	-- find enemies
	local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
		self:GetCaster():GetTeamNumber(),	-- int, your team number
		self:GetParent():GetOrigin(),	-- point, center point
		nil,	-- handle, cacheUnit. (not known)
		self.radius,	-- float, radius. or use FIND_UNITS_EVERYWHERE
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,	-- int, team filter
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,	-- int, type filter
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE,	-- int, flag filter
		0,	-- int, order filter
		false	-- bool, can grow cache
	)

	for _,enemy in pairs(enemies) do
		-- create projectile effect
		local effect = self:PlayEffects1( enemy, self.info.iMoveSpeed )

		-- launch attack
		self.info.Target = enemy
		self.info.ExtraData.effect = effect

		ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile( self.info )

		-- play effects
		local sound_cast = "Hero_DarkWillow.WillOWisp.Damage"
		EmitSoundOn( sound_cast, self:GetParent() )

		-- only on first unit
		break
	end
end

	local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle( particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, self:GetParent() )

	-- ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 1, Vector( self.radius, self.radius, self.radius ) )

	-- buff particle
	self:AddParticle(

		false, -- bStatusEffect
		-1, -- iPriority
		false, -- bHeroEffect
		false -- bOverheadEffect
	)

	local particle_cast = "particles/units/heroes/hero_dark_willow/dark_willow_willowisp_base_attack.vpcf"
	-- local effect_cast = assert(loadfile("lua_abilities/rubick_spell_steal_lua/rubick_spell_steal_lua_arcana"))(self, particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, target )
	local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle( particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, self:GetParent() )

	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(

function m_modifier_earthshaker_aftershock:OnAbilityFullyCast(params)
    if IsServer() then
        local ability = params.ability
        if params.unit ~= self:GetParent() or ability:IsItem() then return end
        
        local behavior = ability:GetBehavior()
        if bit.band(behavior, DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_CHANNELLED) ~= 0 then
            return 
        end
        if ability:GetName() == 'earthshaker_enchant_totem' then
            local caster = self:GetParent()
			local target = ability:GetCursorTarget()
			--强化图腾跳跃 才做这个特殊处理
            if caster:HasScepter() and not target then
                --系统会自己补一个余震特效 和 晕眩

        self:GetCaster():GetOrigin(),                   -- point, center point

        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,                    -- int, team filter
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC, -- int, type filter
        0,                                              -- int, flag filter
        0,                                              -- int, order filter
        false                                           -- bool, can grow cache
    )

    -- apply stun and damage
    for _, enemy in pairs(enemies) do
        enemy:AddNewModifier(

            self:GetAbility(),           -- ability source
            "modifier_stunned",          -- modifier name
            { duration = self.duration } -- kv
        )

        self.damageTable.victim = enemy
        ApplyDamage(self.damageTable)
    end

    -- Effects
	if not no_effect then
	    self:PlayEffects()
	end

    -- Get Resources

    local radius = self:get_radius()
    local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, self:GetParent())
    ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(effect_cast, 1, Vector(radius, radius, radius))
    ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(effect_cast)
end

function ember_spirit_searing_chains:OnSpellStart()
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local center = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
	local hits = {}
	self:effect(hits, caster, center)

    if caster:GetHeroFacetID() == 2 then
        self:Check_Remnant()
    end
end

function ember_spirit_searing_chains:effect(hits, caster, center)
    -- Get data
    local duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
    caster:EmitSound("Hero_EmberSpirit.SearingChains.Cast")
    local pfx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
        "particles/units/heroes/hero_ember_spirit/ember_spirit_searing_chains_cast.vpcf",
        PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, caster)
    ParticleManager:SetParticleControlForward(pfx, 0, caster:GetForwardVector())
    ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(pfx, 1, Vector(self:GetSpecialValueFor("radius"), 0, 0))
    ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(pfx)

    local chains = self:GetSpecialValueFor("unit_count")
    local heroes = FindUnitsInRadius(caster:GetTeamNumber(), center, nil, self:GetSpecialValueFor("radius"),
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE, FIND_CLOSEST, false)
    local units = FindUnitsInRadius(
        caster:GetTeamNumber(), 
        center, 
        nil, 
        self:GetSpecialValueFor("radius"),
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, 
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE, 
        FIND_CLOSEST, 
        false)
    for k, v in pairs(units) do heroes[#heroes + 1] = v end

    local count = 0
    for i = 1, #heroes do
        local target = heroes[i]
        if not hits[target] then
            target:AddNewModifier(caster, self, "modifier_ember_spirit_searing_chains", {
                duration = duration
            })
            target:EmitSound("Hero_EmberSpirit.SearingChains.Target")
            target:EmitSound("Hero_EmberSpirit.SearingChains.Burn")
            local pfx_chain = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
                "particles/units/heroes/hero_ember_spirit/ember_spirit_searing_chains_start.vpcf",
                PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, target)
            ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(pfx_chain, 0, caster, PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW, "attach_hitloc",
                center, true)
            ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(pfx_chain, 1, target, PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW, "attach_hitloc",
                target:GetAbsOrigin(), true)
            ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(pfx_chain)
            hits[target] = true
            count = count + 1
            if count >= chains then
                break
            end
        end
    end
	-- print("=====本次处理数量",count)
end

function ember_spirit_searing_chains:Add_Remnant(npc)
    -- print("add")
    if not self.remnant then 
        self.remnant = {}
    end

    local remnant ={}
    remnant.timer = GameRules:GetDOTATime(false, false)
    remnant.npc = npc

    table.insert( self.remnant, remnant )
end

function ember_spirit_searing_chains:Check_Remnant()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not self.remnant or #self.remnant == 0 then 
        return
    end
    local now_timer = GameRules:GetDOTATime(false, false)

    for key , remnant in pairs(self.remnant) do
        if now_timer - remnant.timer >= 600 then
            table.remove( self.remnant, key )
        else
            if IsValid(remnant.npc) and not remnant.npc:IsAlive() then
                table.remove( self.remnant, key )
            end
        end
    end

    for key , remnant in pairs(self.remnant) do
        if IsValid(remnant.npc) then
            local center = remnant.npc:GetAbsOrigin()
            local hits = {}
            self:effect(hits, remnant.npc, center)
        end
    end
    -- print(#self.remnant)
end

function modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua:OnAbilityFullyCast( params )
	if IsServer() then
		-- filter
		if #self.pairList<1 then return end
		if not params.target then return end
		if params.target~=self:GetParent() then return end
		if params.ability==self:GetAbility() then return end
		if params.ability.soulbind then return end
		if params.unit:GetTeamNumber()==self:GetParent():GetTeamNumber() then return end

		local targetPairList = {}
		if self.primary then
			targetPairList = self.pairList
		else
			targetPairList = self.pairList
			for k,pair in pairs(self.pairList) do
				if pair.primary then
					for p,opair in pairs(pair.pairList) do
						if opair ~= self then
							table.insert(targetPairList,opair)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for k,pair in pairs(targetPairList) do
			-- check if already has cooldown (mainly for Culling Blade)
			if pair and not pair:IsNull() and pair.GetParent then
				local ready = false
				if params.ability:IsCooldownReady() then
					ready = true
				end

				-- reset ability
				params.ability:EndCooldown()
				params.ability:RefundManaCost()

				-- cast ability
				params.ability.soulbind = true
				params.unit:SetCursorCastTarget( pair:GetParent() )
				params.ability:CastAbility()
				params.ability.soulbind = nil

				-- refund cooldown if initially does not have cooldown
				if not (params.ability:IsCooldownReady()==ready) then
					-- end cooldown for the second time
					params.ability:EndCooldown()
				end
			end
		end

		-- play effects
		self:PlayEffects3(targetPairList)
	end
end

function modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua:OnIntervalThink()
	if self.primary then
		for i = #self.pairList , 1 , -1 do
			local pair = self.pairList[i]
			if pair and pair:IsNull() then
				self:PlayEffects2( false, pair)
				table.remove( self.pairList, pair)
				pair = nil
			end
		end
	end
	-- if no pair, seek for pair
	if self.primary and #self.pairList < self.pairMax then
		self:FindPair()
	end
	--讲道理非主buff不应该这里有buff为空
	for i = #self.pairList , 1 , -1 do
		local pair = self.pairList[i]
		if pair and pair:IsNull() then
			table.remove( self.pairList, pair)
			pair = nil
		end
	end
	-- movement speed calculations
	if #self.pairList > 0 then
		self:Bind()
	end

	-- 根据 pairList 动态修改状态
    if #self.pairList > 0 then
        self.isTethered = true
    else
        self.isTethered = false
    end
end

function modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua:FindPair()
	-- find enemy heroes
	local heroes = FindUnitsInRadius(
		self:GetCaster():GetTeamNumber(),	-- int, your team number
		self:GetParent():GetOrigin(),	-- point, center point
		nil,	-- handle, cacheUnit. (not known)
		self.radius,	-- float, radius. or use FIND_UNITS_EVERYWHERE
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,	-- int, team filter
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,	-- int, type filter
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS,	-- int, flag filter
		FIND_CLOSEST,	-- int, order filter
		false	-- bool, can grow cache
	)

	-- find targeted heroes
	local target = nil
	local targetList = {}
	for _,hero in pairs(heroes) do
		if hero~=self:GetParent() then
			-- check if already has modifier
			if (not hero:HasModifier( "modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua" )) then
				target = hero
				table.insert( targetList, target )
				if #targetList>=(self.pairMax-#self.pairList) then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- add found target
	for k,v in pairs(targetList) do
		local target = v
		if target then
			local pairindex = AddATValue( self )
			local pair = target:AddNewModifier(
				self:GetCaster(), -- player source
				self:GetAbility(), -- ability source
				"modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua", -- modifier name
				{
					primary = false,
					pair = pairindex,
					pairMax = self.pairMax
				} -- kv
			)
			table.insert( self.pairList, pair )
			self:PlayEffects2( true ,pair)
		end
	end
end

function modifier_grimstroke_soulbind_lua:Bind()
	local tempList = {}
	self.limit = self.normal_ms_limit
	for k,pair in pairs(self.pairList) do
		local limit
		-- get info
		local vectorToPair = pair:GetParent():GetOrigin() - self:GetParent():GetOrigin()
		local facingAngle = self:GetParent():GetAnglesAsVector().y

		-- calculate facing angle
		local angleToPair = VectorToAngles(vectorToPair).y
		local angleDifference = math.abs(AngleDiff( angleToPair, facingAngle ))

		-- calculate distance
		local distanceToPair = vectorToPair:Length2D()

		-- check if it is within boundaries
		if distanceToPair < self.buffer_radius then
			-- within limit
			limit = self.normal_ms_limit

		elseif distanceToPair < self.break_radius then
			-- slowed if facing away
			if angleDifference > 90 then
				-- slow interpolates linearly between buffer radius and chain radius
				local interpolate = math.min( (distanceToPair-self.buffer_radius)/self.buffer, 1 )

				-- slow inversely related with interpolation
				limit = (1-interpolate) * self.normal_ms_limit

				-- 0 limit means no limit
				if limit < 1 then
					limit = 0.01
				end
			else
				-- not slowed if facing towards pair
				limit = self.normal_ms_limit
			end

			-- interrupts weak motion controllers
			self:GetParent():InterruptMotionControllers( true )
		else
			-- outside, break
			limit = self.normal_ms_limit
			if self.primary then
				pair:Destroy()
				table.insert( tempList, pair)
				self:PlayEffects2( false,pair )
			end
		end
		self.limit = math.min(self.limit,limit)
	end
	for k,v in pairs(tempList) do
		table.remove( self.pairList, v )
		v = nil
	end
end

function hoodwink_sharpshooter:OnSpellStart()
    local caster = self:GetCaster()     -- 获取施法者
    local point = self:GetCursorPosition() -- 获取鼠标指向的位置

    -- 获取技能特殊值 misfire_time，作为修饰符的持续时间
    local duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor("misfire_time")

    local caster_pos = caster:GetOrigin()
    local distance = (point - caster_pos):Length2D()
    if distance < 10 then -- 距离小于10单位视为重合（1码约为128单位）
        -- 计算角色前方1码的位置（1码=128单位，这里使用100作为示例）
        local forward = caster:GetForwardVector()
        point = caster_pos + forward * 100
    end

    -- 如果施法者没有名为 "hoodwink_sharpshooter_release" 的次级技能，则添加并设置等级
    -- 这个次级技能用于在充能期间“中止”主技能
    if not caster:FindAbilityByName("hoodwink_sharpshooter_release") then
        local ability = caster:AddAbility("hoodwink_sharpshooter_release")
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    -- 为施法者添加主修饰符 modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua
    -- 这个修饰符控制技能的充能、瞄准、技能替换等核心逻辑
    caster:AddNewModifier(
        caster,                         -- 玩家来源 (施法者)
        self,                           -- 技能来源 (当前技能)
        "modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua", -- 修饰符名称
        {
            duration = duration,        -- 修饰符持续时间 (即充能最长时间)
            x = point.x,

    )

function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:effect(pct, direction, pos, vec)
    local info = table.copy(self.info) -- 复制投射物信息表格
    -- 准备投射物发射信息
    info.vSpawnOrigin = pos         -- 投射物生成位置 (施法者原点)
    info.vVelocity = vec      -- 投射物速度向量 (方向 * 速度)

    -- 创建一个用于播放投射物音效的 Thinker 实体
    local sound = CreateModifierThinker(
        self.caster,       -- 玩家来源
        self,              -- 技能来源
        "",                -- 没有修饰符名称，只是一个临时的 Thinker
        {},                -- kv 数据
        self.caster:GetOrigin(), -- 生成位置
        self.team,         -- 队伍
        false              -- 不作为状态修饰符
    )
    local sound_cast = "Hero_Hoodwink.Sharpshooter.Projectile"
    EmitSoundOn(sound_cast, sound) -- 播放投射物飞行音效

    -- 将伤害、持续时间、方向和音效实体索引作为额外数据传递给投射物
    info.ExtraData = {
        damage = self.damage * pct, -- 根据充能百分比计算最终伤害
        duration = self.duration * pct, -- 根据充能百分比计算最终减速持续时间
        x = direction.x,
        y = direction.y,
        sound = sound:entindex(),                 -- 传递音效实体的索引 唯一的声音实体
    }
    ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(info) -- **关键：创建线性投射物并发射**

end

-- 修饰符被销毁时的逻辑 (无论是到期、被驱散还是主动中止)
function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end -- 确保只在服务器端运行

    -- 计算投射物方向 (当前单位朝向)
    local direction = self.current_dir

    -- 计算充能百分比 (当前已充能时间 / 最大充能时间)
    local pct = math.min(self:GetElapsedTime(), self.charge) / self.charge
    local pos = self.parent:GetOrigin()
    local vec = direction * self.projectile_speed

    self:effect(pct, direction, pos, vec)
    if self.mulcount > 0 then
        for i = 1, self.mulcount do
            local new_direction = RotatePosition(Vector(0, 0, 0), QAngle(0, -90 + i * 60, 0), direction)
            local new_vec = new_direction * self.projectile_speed
            self:effect(pct, new_direction, pos, new_vec)
        end
    end
    -- 初始觉醒
    for i = 1, self.recount do
        Timers:CreateTimer(0.3 * i, function()
            if self.caster:IsAlive() then
                self:effect(pct, direction, pos, vec)
                if self.mulcount > 0 then
                    for j = 1, self.mulcount do
                        local new_direction = RotatePosition(Vector(0, 0, 0), QAngle(0, -90 + j * 60, 0), direction)
                        local new_vec = new_direction * self.projectile_speed
                        self:effect(pct, new_direction, pos, new_vec)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    -- 施法者自身后坐力修饰符
    local mod = self.caster:AddNewModifier(
        self.caster,                -- 玩家来源
        self,                       -- 技能来源
        "modifier_generic_knockback_lua", -- 后坐力修饰符名称
        {
            duration = self.recoil_duration, -- 后坐力持续时间
            height = self.recoil_height, -- 后坐力高度
            distance = self.recoil_distance, -- 后坐力距离
            direction_x = -direction.x, -- 后坐力方向 (与箭矢方向相反)
            direction_y = -direction.y,
        }                           -- kv 数据
    )

    -- 技能交换：将次级技能 hoodwink_sharpshooter_release 隐藏，显示主技能 hoodwink_sharpshooter
    self.caster:SwapAbilities("hoodwink_sharpshooter", "hoodwink_sharpshooter_release", true, false)

    -- 播放发射后的特效
    self:PlayEffects4(mod)
end

-- 辅助函数

-- 设置目标方向
function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:SetDirection(vec)
    -- 将鼠标位置转换为与施法者原点相对的标准化方向向量
    self.target_dir = ((vec - self.parent:GetOrigin()) * Vector(1, 1, 0)):Normalized()
    self.face_target = false -- 标记为需要转向
end

-- 转向逻辑 (使单位平滑地转向目标方向)
function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:TurnLogic()
    if self.face_target then return end -- 如果已经面向目标，则不执行

    local current_angle = VectorToAngles(self.current_dir).y
    local target_angle = VectorToAngles(self.target_dir).y
    local angle_diff = AngleDiff(current_angle, target_angle) -- 计算角度差

    local sign = -1
    if angle_diff < 0 then sign = 1 end -- 根据角度差决定旋转方向

    -- 如果角度差很小，则直接设置为目标方向，结束旋转
    if math.abs(angle_diff) < 1.1 * self.turn_speed then
        self.current_dir = self.target_dir
        self.face_target = true
    else
        -- 否则，按转向速度旋转当前方向
        self.current_dir = RotatePosition(Vector(0, 0, 0), QAngle(0, sign * self.turn_speed, 0), self.current_dir)
    end

    -- 如果单位没有被水平或垂直运动控制，则设置其朝向
    local a = self.parent:IsCurrentlyHorizontalMotionControlled()
    local b = self.parent:IsCurrentlyVerticalMotionControlled()
    if not (a or b) then
        self.parent:SetForwardVector(self.current_dir)
    end
end

-- 更新修饰符的堆栈计数 (用于客户端显示充能百分比)
function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:UpdateStack()
    local pct = math.min(self:GetElapsedTime(), self.charge) / self.charge
    pct = math.floor(pct * 100) -- 转换为百分比整数
    self:SetStackCount(pct)  -- 设置堆栈计数
end

-- 命令过滤器 (用于拦截和修改单位的命令)
function modifier_hoodwink_sharpshooter_lua:OrderFilter(data)
    if #data.units > 1 then return true end -- 如果选择多个单位，则不处理

    local unit
    for _, id in pairs(data.units) do
        unit = EntIndexToHScript(id)
    end
    if unit ~= self.parent then return true end -- 确保是修饰符持有者

    -- 如果是移动到位置命令，则转换为移动到方向命令，并传递鼠标位置
    if data.order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION then
        data.order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION
        -- 如果是攻击目标或移动到目标命令，则转换为移动到方向命令，并传递目标位置
    elseif data.order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET or data.order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET then
        local pos = EntIndexToHScript(data.entindex_target):GetOrigin()

        data.order_type = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION
        data.position_x = pos.x
        data.position_y = pos.y
        data.position_z = pos.z
    end

    return true -- 继续处理命令
end

modifier_generic_knockback_lua = class({})

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 分类信息
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:IsHidden()
    return true -- 隐藏修饰符，玩家看不到
end

function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:IsPurgable()
    return false -- 不可驱散
end

function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE -- 允许同时存在多个此修饰符 (如果需要)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 初始化 (修饰符被创建时)
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:OnCreated(kv)
    if IsServer() then -- 确保只在服务器端运行
        -- 获取击退参数
        self.distance = kv.distance or 0
        self.height = kv.height or -1
        self.duration = kv.duration or 0
        if kv.direction_x and kv.direction_y then
            self.direction = Vector(kv.direction_x, kv.direction_y, 0):Normalized()
        else
            self.direction = -(self:GetParent():GetForwardVector())        -- 默认向后击退
        end
        self.tree = kv.tree_destroy_radius or self:GetParent():GetHullRadius() -- 摧毁树木半径

        if kv.IsStun then self.stun = kv.IsStun == 1 else self.stun = false end -- 是否眩晕
        if kv.IsFlail then self.flail = kv.IsFlail == 1 else self.flail = true end -- 是否播放浮空动画

        if self.duration == 0 then                                         -- 如果持续时间为0，则立即销毁
            self:Destroy()
            return
        end

        self.parent = self:GetParent()
        self.origin = self.parent:GetOrigin()

        -- 水平速度计算
        self.hVelocity = self.distance / self.duration

        -- 垂直速度计算 (抛物线运动)
        local half_duration = self.duration / 2
        self.gravity = 2 * self.height / (half_duration * half_duration)
        self.vVelocity = self.gravity * half_duration

        -- 应用水平和垂直运动控制器
        if self.distance > 0 then
            if self:ApplyHorizontalMotionController() == false then
                self:Destroy()
                return
            end
        end
        if self.height >= 0 then
            if self:ApplyVerticalMotionController() == false then
                self:Destroy()
                return
            end
        end

        -- 通知客户端动画状态
        if self.flail then
            self:SetStackCount(1)
        elseif self.stun then
            self:SetStackCount(2)
        end
    else -- 客户端代码
        self.anim = self:GetStackCount()
        self:SetStackCount(0)
    end
end

function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:OnRefresh(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end
end

function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:OnDestroy(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if not self.interrupted then -- 如果不是被中断销毁
        -- 销毁树木
        if self.tree > 0 then
            GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint(self:GetParent():GetOrigin(), self.tree, true)
        end
    end

    if self.EndCallback then -- 如果有结束回调函数，则调用
        self.EndCallback(self.interrupted)
    end

    self:GetParent():InterruptMotionControllers(true) -- 中断运动控制器
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Setter
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:SetEndCallback(func)
    self.EndCallback = func
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 修饰符声明函数
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:DeclareFunctions()
    local funcs = {
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_OVERRIDE_ANIMATION, -- 覆盖动画
    }

    return funcs
end

-- 覆盖动画，根据 stack count 播放浮空或眩晕动画
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:GetOverrideAnimation(params)
    if self.anim == 1 then
        return ACT_DOTA_FLAIL
    elseif self.anim == 2 then
        return ACT_DOTA_DISABLED
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 状态效果
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:CheckState()
    local state = {
        [MODIFIER_STATE_STUNNED] = self.stun, -- 根据 stun 标志决定是否眩晕
    }

    return state
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 运动效果

-- 更新水平运动
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local target = self.direction * self.distance * (dt / self.duration) -- 计算本次移动的向量
    parent:SetOrigin(parent:GetOrigin() + target)               -- 更新位置
end

-- 水平运动被中断时
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:OnHorizontalMotionInterrupted()
    if IsServer() then
        self.interrupted = true
        self:Destroy() -- 销毁修饰符
    end
end

-- 更新垂直运动
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:UpdateVerticalMotion(me, dt)
    local time = dt / self.duration                                                   -- 归一化的时间增量
    self.parent:SetOrigin(self.parent:GetOrigin() + Vector(0, 0, self.vVelocity * dt)) -- 更新垂直位置
    self.vVelocity = self.vVelocity - self.gravity * dt                               -- 更新垂直速度
end

-- 垂直运动被中断时
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:OnVerticalMotionInterrupted()
    if IsServer() then
        self.interrupted = true
        self:Destroy() -- 销毁修饰符
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 图像与动画 (击退修饰符相关粒子)
function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:GetEffectName()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if self.stun then
        return "particles/generic_gameplay/generic_stunned.vpcf" -- 眩晕粒子
    end
end

function modifier_generic_knockback_lua:GetEffectAttachType()
    if not IsServer() then return end
    return PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW -- 附加点为头顶
end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not self:GetParent():FindAbilityByName("huskar_berserkers_blood") then return 0 end
    local ability = self:GetParent():FindAbilityByName("huskar_berserkers_blood")
    if ability:GetLevel() < 1 then return 0 end
    local attacker = params.attacker
    local damaged_unit = params.target
    local damage_after = params.damage -- after reductions
    local damage_before = params.original_damage -- before reductions
    local damage_flags = params.damage_flags

    end

    if parent:IsIllusion() then

    end

    end

        end
        
        -- 计算即死阈值（最大生命值的kill_pct%）
        ice_blast_threshold = parent:GetMaxHealth() * (kill_pct / 100)
    end
    
    -- 正常情况：伤害将导致死亡时触发无敌

        end
        if im_level > 1 then
            parent:Purge(false, true, false, true, true)
        end
        return 1
    else
        return 0
    end
end

    local hero = self:GetParent()
    local pos = self:GetParent():GetCursorPosition()
    local point = self:GetParent():GetOrigin()

    if GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty() >= 0 then

        ability:OnSpellStart()
        hero:SetCursorPosition(p2)
        ability:OnSpellStart()

                -- 释放到 p1 位置

                dual_breath:OnSpellStart()
                -- 释放到 p2 位置
                hero:SetCursorPosition(p2)
                dual_breath:OnSpellStart()
            end
            if hero:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_ice_path") then
                local ice_path = hero:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_ice_path")
                -- 释放到 p1 位置
                hero:SetCursorPosition(p1)
                ice_path:OnSpellStart()
                -- 释放到 p2 位置
                hero:SetCursorPosition(p2)
                ice_path:OnSpellStart()
            end
        end
    end
    
    if GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty() >= 1 then
        -- *** 参考卡尔的方法：直接用本体技能 ***
        if hero:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_dual_breath") then
            local dual_breath = hero:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_dual_breath")
            hero:SetCursorPosition(pos)

        end
        if hero:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_ice_path") then

            hero:SetCursorPosition(pos)
            ice_path:OnSpellStart()
        end
    end
end

function lich_chain_frost:OnProjectileHit_ExtraData(target, location, keys)
	local bounces = keys.bounces + 1
    local caster = self.caster
    local dmg = self:GetSpecialValueFor("damage") + self:GetSpecialValueFor("bonus_jump_damage") * keys.bounces
    local damage_flags = DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_NONE
    local radius = self:GetSpecialValueFor("jump_range")
    local jumps = self.jumps
    local ICE_SPIRE_DAMAGE_PER_HIT = 2
	--target为空 未击中目标
	if not target then
		return 
	end

    local check_sphere = false
    if keys.first == 1 then
        target:TriggerSpellReflect(self) --触发反弹 刃甲 莲华
        check_sphere =  target:HasSphere()
        target:TriggerSpellAbsorb(self) --触发吸收 林肯 校验林肯
        target:InterruptChannel()      --打断施法
    end
    target:EmitSound("Hero_Lich.ChainFrostImpact.Hero")

	local myteam = caster:GetTeamNumber()

    if target:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_lich_ice_spire" then
        -- 检查冰柱是否有生命值组件
        if target:IsAlive() and target.GetHealth then
            -- 扣除冰柱生命值
            local currentHealth = target:GetHealth()
            if currentHealth > ICE_SPIRE_DAMAGE_PER_HIT then
                target:SetHealth(currentHealth - ICE_SPIRE_DAMAGE_PER_HIT)
            else
                -- 冰柱生命值耗尽，摧毁它
                target:ForceKill(false)
            end
        end
    elseif target:GetTeamNumber() ~= myteam and not check_sphere then
        -- 原有逻辑：对敌方单位施加减速和伤害
        target:AddNewModifier(caster, self, "modifier_rain_chain_frost", {
            duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor("slow_duration")
        })
        local damageTable = {
            victim = target,
            attacker = caster,
            damage = dmg,
            damage_type = self.damage_type,
            damage_flags = damage_flags,     -- Optional.
            ability = self                   -- Optional.
        }
        ApplyDamage(damageTable)
    end
    
	--命石天赋2 需要动态增加弹射次数   bonus_jumps_per_hero_killed  bonus_jumps_per_creep_killed
    if bounces > (jumps + self.kill_add) and self.has_unlimited_jumps == 0 then
        return
    end
    
	local next_target = self:search_unit(target,radius, location,1)

    if next_target then
		self:do_effect(next_target, target, location, bounces,1)
	else
		-- 如果是命石1 添加一个延迟的modifier 
		if self.frostbound_duration > 0 then
			target:AddNewModifier(caster, self, "m_modifier_lich_chainfrost_frostbound", {
				duration = self.frostbound_duration,
				radius = radius,
				bounces = bounces,
			})
		end
    end
	return true
end


function lich_chain_frost:do_effect(target,source,location,bounces,ff)

	local info = {
		Target = target,
		Source = source,
		Ability = self,
		EffectName = self.pfx_name,
		iMoveSpeed = self.speed,
		vSourceLoc = location,              -- Optional (HOW)
		bDrawsOnMinimap = false,            -- Optional
		bDodgeable = false,                 -- Optional
		bIsAttack = false,                  -- Optional
		bVisibleToEnemies = true,           -- Optional
		bReplaceExisting = false,           -- Optional
		flExpireTime = GameRules:GetGameTime() + 60, -- Optional but recommended
		bProvidesVision = false,            -- Optional
		ExtraData = {
			first = 0,
			bounces = bounces
		}
	}
	ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
end

--在某个坐标点搜寻 
function lich_chain_frost:search_unit(target,radius,loc,ff)
	
	local caster = self.caster --巫妖本体
	if not caster then
		return 
	end

	local location = loc or target:GetAbsOrigin()
	local myteam = caster:GetTeamNumber()

    local hero_got = false
    local next_target = nil
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(myteam, location, nil, radius,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE,
        FIND_CLOSEST, false)
    for _, enemy in pairs(enemies) do
        if enemy ~= target then
            next_target = enemy
            hero_got = true
            break
        end
    end
    if not hero_got then
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(myteam, location, nil, radius,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE,
			FIND_CLOSEST, false)
        for _, enemy in pairs(enemies) do
            if enemy ~= target and not string.find(enemy:GetUnitName(), "npc_dota_unit_undying_zombie") then
                next_target = enemy
				hero_got = true
                break
            end
        end

        if not hero_got then
			--冰柱或者自己
            local ice_spires = FindUnitsInRadius(myteam, location, nil, radius,
                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_ALL,
                DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_NONE,
                FIND_CLOSEST, false)
            for _, ice_spire in pairs(ice_spires) do
                if ice_spire ~= target and (ice_spire:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_lich_ice_spire" or ice_spire == caster) then
                    next_target = ice_spire
                    hero_got = false
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
	return next_target
end

-- Ability Start
lion_mana_drain.modifiers = {}
function lion_mana_drain:OnSpellStart()
	-- unit identifier
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	local target = self:GetCursorTarget()

	-- cancel if linken
	if target:TriggerSpellAbsorb(self) then
		caster:Interrupt()
		return
	end

	-- load data
	local duration = self:GetChannelTime()

	--这里处理多人 根据魔晶 额外增加
	local hit_count = self:GetSpecialValueFor("shard_bonus_targets")
	local fRadius = self:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), nil)

	-- register modifier (in case for multi-target)
	local modifier = target:AddNewModifier(
		caster,                          -- player source
		self,                            -- ability source
		"m_modifier_lion_mana_drain",    -- modifier name
		{ duration = duration, is_base = true } -- kv
	)

	if not modifier then
		return
	end

	self.modifiers[modifier] = true

	if hit_count > 0 and caster:HasShard() then
		--魔晶效果
		caster:AddNewModifier(
			caster,
			self,
			"modifier_lion_mana_drain_immunity",
			{ duration = duration }
		)

		--额外2个单位
		local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
			caster:GetTeamNumber(), caster:GetAbsOrigin(), nil, fRadius,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
			FIND_ANY_ORDER, false)
		local add_count = 0
		for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
			if enemy ~= target then
				add_count = add_count + 1
				local modifier = enemy:AddNewModifier(
					caster,        -- player source
					self,          -- ability source
					"m_modifier_lion_mana_drain", -- modifier name
					{ duration = duration } -- kv
				)
				self.modifiers[modifier] = true
				if add_count >= hit_count then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- play effects
	self.sound_cast = "Hero_Lion.ManaDrain"
	EmitSoundOn(self.sound_cast, caster)
end

function lion_mana_drain:OnChannelFinish(bInterrupted)
	-- destroy all modifier
	for modifier, _ in pairs(self.modifiers) do
		if not modifier:IsNull() then
			modifier.forceDestroy = bInterrupted
			modifier:Destroy()
		end
	end
	self.modifiers = {}

	-- end sound
	StopSoundOn(self.sound_cast, self:GetCaster())
end

function lion_mana_drain:Unregister(modifier)
	-- unregister modifier
	self.modifiers[modifier] = nil

	-- check if there are no modifier left
	local counter = 0
	for modifier, _ in pairs(self.modifiers) do
		if not modifier:IsNull() then
			counter = counter + 1
		end
	end

	-- stop channelling if no other target exist
	if counter == 0 and self:IsChanneling() then
		self:EndChannel(false)
	end
end

function lion_mana_drain:CastFilterResultTarget(target)
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	-- 如果目标是友军，允许施法
	if target:GetTeamNumber() == caster:GetTeamNumber() and not target:IsBuilding() then

	return UnitFilter(target, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE, caster:GetTeamNumber())
end

	local ability = self:GetAbility()

	self.base_mane = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("mana_per_second")
	self.radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("break_distance")
	self.slow = -ability:GetSpecialValueFor("movespeed")
	self.add_slow = -ability:GetSpecialValueFor("movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct")
	self.damage = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("damage_pct")
	self.is_empty = false
	self.is_enemy = true
	local interval = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("tick_interval")

	local target = self:GetParent() --目标对象
	local caster = self:GetCaster() --施法者

	self.mana = self.base_mane * interval

	--如果是友军 并且不是自己
	if target:GetTeamNumber() == caster:GetTeamNumber() then
		if target ~= caster then
			self.mana = self.mana / 2
		end
		self.slow = self.slow * -0.5
		self.add_slow = self.add_slow * -1
		self.is_enemy = false
	end

	if IsServer() then
		self.parent = target
		-- Start interval
		self:StartIntervalThink(interval)

		-- play effects

-- Interval Effects
function m_modifier_lion_mana_drain:OnIntervalThink()
	-- check illusion, magic immune, or invulnerable
	local target = self:GetParent()
	local hero = self:GetCaster()
	local ability = self:GetAbility()
	if target:IsInvulnerable() or (target:IsIllusion() and not target:IsStrongIllusion()) then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end

	-- check distance
	if (target:GetOrigin() - hero:GetOrigin()):Length2D() > self.radius then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end

	local mana = target:GetMana()
	local max_mana = target:GetMaxMana()
	local add_mana = self.mana

	--判断 三种对象  友军 自己  敌人
	if target == hero then
		hero:GiveMana(self.mana)
	elseif target:GetTeamNumber() == hero:GetTeamNumber() then
		--友军满蓝 自己不扣蓝
		--友军
		if max_mana < mana + add_mana then
			add_mana = max_mana - mana
		end
		target:GiveMana(add_mana)
		hero:Script_ReduceMana(add_mana, ability)
	else
		--敌人空蓝，自己不加蓝
		--敌人
		if mana < add_mana then
			add_mana = mana
			self.is_empty = true
		else
			self.is_empty = false
		end
		hero:GiveMana(add_mana)
		target:Script_ReduceMana(add_mana, ability)

		if self.damage > 0 then
			local damageTable = {
				victim = target,
				attacker = hero,
				damage = add_mana,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
				damage_flags = DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_NONE,
				ability = ability -- Optional.
			}
			ApplyDamage(damageTable)
		end
	end
end

	-- Create Particle
	local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particle_cast, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, self:GetParent())
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(
		effect_cast,
		0,
		self:GetParent(),
		PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW,
		"attach_hitloc",
		Vector(0, 0, 0), -- unknown

	)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(

function mirana_arrow:OnSpellStart()
    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local ability = self
    local sound = "Hero_Mirana.ArrowCast"
    local particle = "particles/units/heroes/hero_mirana/mirana_spell_arrow.vpcf"
    local targetPoint = self:GetCursorPosition()
    local direction = (targetPoint - caster:GetAbsOrigin()):Normalized()

    local spawnPoint = caster:GetAbsOrigin() + direction * 51
    
    --自己的参数
    self.originPoint = caster:GetOrigin()
    self.unittable = {}
    -- Ability specials
    local arrow_speed = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_speed")
    local arrow_width = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_width")
    local arrow_range = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_range")
    local maxtime = GameRules:GetGameTime() + math.ceil(arrow_range / arrow_speed) -- 计算最大飞行时间

    local projectile = {Ability = ability,
                        EffectName = particle,
                        vSpawnOrigin = spawnPoint,
                        fDistance = arrow_range,
                        fStartRadius = arrow_width,
                        fEndRadius = arrow_width,
                        fExpireTime = maxtime,
                        Source = caster,
                        bHasFrontalCone = false,
                        bReplaceExisting = false,
                        iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,                                                          
                        iUnitTargetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,                         
                        bDeleteOnHit = true,
                        vVelocity = direction * arrow_speed,
                        bProvidesVision = false, 
                        iVisionRadius = 100,
                        iVisionTeamNumber = caster:GetTeamNumber()                      
    }

    ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(projectile)


    local arrow_num = 0
    if caster:HasTalent("special_bonus_unique_mirana_2") then
        arrow_num = arrow_num + 1
    end
    if GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty() >= 2 then
        arrow_num = arrow_num + 1
    end

    if arrow_num > 0 then
        for i = 1,arrow_num do
            local point = caster:GetOrigin()
            local newpoint = RotatePosition(point, QAngle(0, 25 * i, 0), targetPoint)
            local p = projectile
            
            direction = (newpoint - caster:GetAbsOrigin()):Normalized()
            p.vVelocity = direction * arrow_speed
            ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(p)
    
            newpoint = RotatePosition(point, QAngle(0, 360 -(25 * i), 0), targetPoint)
            direction = (newpoint - caster:GetAbsOrigin()):Normalized()
            p.vVelocity = direction * arrow_speed
            ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(p)
        end
    end
    EmitSoundOn(sound, caster)
end

function mirana_arrow:OnProjectileHit(target, location)    
    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local ability = self
    local modifier = "modifier_stunned"
    local soundImpact = "Hero_Mirana.ArrowImpact"
    if not target then return end

    if not target:IsConsideredHero() then
        local targetName = target:GetUnitName()
        if not nokills[targetName] then
            target:Kill(caster, caster)
            return
        end
    end
    
    local function CalculateDistance(point1, point2)
        local dx = point1.x - point2.x
        local dy = point1.y - point2.y
        local dz = point1.z - point2.z
        return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
    end
    
    local pass_distance = CalculateDistance(target:GetOrigin(),self.originPoint)
    local pct = pass_distance / ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_max_stunrange")
    if pct > 1 then pct = 1 end

    local stun_duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_min_stun")
    local plus_time = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_max_stun") * pct
    stun_duration = stun_duration + plus_time

    target:AddNewModifier(
        self:GetCaster(), 
        self, 
        modifier, 
        {duration = stun_duration}
    )
    
    local damage = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("#AbilityDamage")
    local arrow_bonus_damage = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_bonus_damage") * pct
    damage = damage + arrow_bonus_damage


    local damageTable = {
        victim = target,
        attacker = caster,
        damage = damage,
        damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
        ability = ability
    }

    ApplyDamage(damageTable)    

	AddFOWViewer(self:GetCaster():GetTeam(), location, self:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_vision"), 3, false)

    -- Sound removed so you can hear the bell ring
    EmitSoundOn(soundImpact, target)

    if caster:HasScepter() then
        if caster:FindAbilityByName("mirana_starfall") then
            local skill = caster:FindAbilityByName("mirana_starfall")
            if skill:GetLevel() > 0 then
                local sf_damage = skill:GetSpecialValueFor("damage") * ability:GetSpecialValueFor("scepter_starstorm_target_pct") * 0.01
                self:DoStarFall(target,caster,sf_damage,ability)
            end
        end
    end 

    return true
end

function mirana_arrow:OnProjectileThink(location)
    --视野
	AddFOWViewer(self:GetCaster():GetTeam(), location, self:GetSpecialValueFor("arrow_vision"), 0.3, false)

    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    if not caster:HasScepter() then return end -- 没有A杖跳出
    if not caster:FindAbilityByName("mirana_starfall") then return end -- 没有星落跳出
    local skill = caster:FindAbilityByName("mirana_starfall")
    if skill:GetLevel() < 1 then return end -- 没学星落跳出

    --星落
    local ability = self
    local myteam = caster:GetTeam()
    local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("scepter_radius")

    local units = FindUnitsInRadius(
        myteam, location, nil, radius,
	DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, 
    DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
	DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE,
	FIND_ANY_ORDER, false)


    local damage = skill:GetSpecialValueFor("damage")
    for _, unit in pairs(units) do
        if unit:IsAlive() then  -- 确保单位是活着的
            if unit:GetTeam() ~= caster:GetTeam() then -- 确保不同阵营
                local unitID = unit:GetEntityIndex()
    
                if not self.unittable[unitID] then
                    self.unittable[unitID] = true  -- 将单位 ID 添加到表中
                    self:DoStarFall(unit,caster,damage,ability)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function mirana_arrow:PlayEffects(ntarget)
    local pfx_name = "particles/units/heroes/hero_mirana/mirana_starfall_attack.vpcf"
	if HeroItems:UnitHasItem(self:GetCaster(), "mirana_persona_weapon") then
		pfx_name = "particles/econ/items/mirana/mirana_persona/mirana_starstorm.vpcf"
	end
	local sound_cast = "Ability.StarfallImpact"

	local pfx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(pfx_name, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, ntarget)
	ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(pfx)
	EmitSoundOn(sound_cast, ntarget)
end

function mirana_arrow:DoStarFall(target,caster,damage,ability)
    self:PlayEffects(target)
    Timers:CreateTimer(0.57, function()
        local damageTable = {
            victim = target,
            attacker = caster,
            damage = damage,
            damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
            ability = ability
            }
        if not target:IsMagicImmune() then ApplyDamage(damageTable) end
    end)
end

function modifier_nevermore_necromastery_new:OnCreated(params)
    self.ability = self:GetAbility()
    self.parent = self:GetParent()
    self.necromastery_damage_per_soul = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("necromastery_damage_per_soul")
    self.necromastery_max_souls = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("necromastery_max_souls")
    self.necromastery_soul_release = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("necromastery_soul_release")
    self.necromastery_souls_hero_bonus = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("necromastery_souls_hero_bonus")
    self.frenzy_add = 0
    self.soul_death_release = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("soul_death_release")
    self.crit_pct = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("crit_pct")

        self.iParticleID = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(

        ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(self.iParticleID, 1, self:GetParent(), PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, nil,
            self:GetParent():GetAbsOrigin(), true)
        ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(self.iParticleID, 4, Vector(self:GetStackCount(), self:GetStackCount(), 0))
        self:AddParticle(self.iParticleID, false, false, -1, false, false)
    end
end

function modifier_nevermore_necromastery_new:OnDeath(params)
    local hCaster = self:GetCaster()
    local hParent = self:GetParent()
    if params.unit.IsReincarnating ~= nil and params.unit:IsReincarnating() then
        return
    end

    -- 影魔死亡的处理逻辑
    if hParent == params.unit and not params.unit:IsIllusion() and not self:GetParent():IsReincarnating() then
        -- 2024-12-13 更新 死亡不再掉落灵魂
        -- self:SetStackCount(math.ceil(self:GetStackCount() * (1 - 0.3)))

        -- local hModifier = hParent:FindModifierByName("modifier_nevermore_necromastery_awakening")
        -- if IsValid(hModifier) then
        --     hModifier.heroCounts = 0
        --     hModifier:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
        -- end

        self.requiem_ability = "nevermore_requiem"
        if hParent:HasAbility(self.requiem_ability) then
            local requiem_ability_handler = hParent:FindAbilityByName(self.requiem_ability)
            if requiem_ability_handler then
                if requiem_ability_handler:GetLevel() >= 1 then
                    requiem_ability_handler:OnSpellStart(true)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 加魂逻辑
    if hParent.PassivesDisabled and hParent:PassivesDisabled() then
        return
    end
    if not hParent:IsAlive() then
        return
    end
    if (params.attacker == hParent or (params.unit:GetAbsOrigin() - self:GetCaster():GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D() <= 1800) and not hParent:PassivesDisabled() then
        if params.unit:IsRealHero() and hParent:GetTeam() ~= params.unit:GetTeam() then
            local hModifier = hParent:FindModifierByName("modifier_nevermore_necromastery_awakening")
            if IsValid(hModifier) then
                if hCaster:GetHeroFacetID() == 1 then
                    hModifier.heroCounts = hModifier.heroCounts + 1
                    hModifier:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
                end
            end
            -- hParent:AddNewModifier(hCaster, self:GetAbility(), "modifier_nevermore_necromastery_kill_hero_counter",
            --     nil)
        end

        -- 这里必须重新获取，可以理解为是个local变量，获取前为基础值20 大概率是前后端同步的问题。
        self.necromastery_max_souls = self:GetAbilitySpecialValueFor("necromastery_max_souls") + self.frenzy_add
        
        if self:GetStackCount() < self.necromastery_max_souls then
            local iCount = 1
            local sParticlePath = "particles/units/heroes/hero_nevermore/nevermore_necro_souls.vpcf"

            local iParticleID = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
                ParticleManager:GetParticleReplacement(sParticlePath, hCaster), PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, nil)
            ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(iParticleID, 0, params.unit, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, nil,
                params.unit:GetAbsOrigin(), true)
            ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(iParticleID, 1, hParent, PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW, "attach_hitloc",
                hParent:GetAbsOrigin(), true)
            ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(iParticleID)

            -- + hCaster:GetTalentValue("special_bonus_unique_nevermore_4")
            -- necromastery_max_souls = necromastery_max_souls + hCaster:GetModifierStackCount("modifier_nevermore_necromastery_kill_hero_counter", hCaster)
            self:SetStackCount(math.min(self:GetStackCount() + iCount, self.necromastery_max_souls))
        end
    end
    -- print("xxx", self:GetStackCount() * (1 - self.soul_death_release))
    -- if params.unit == self:GetCaster() then
    --     print("xxx", self:GetStackCount() * (1 - self.soul_death_release))

function modifier_nevermore_necromastery_awakening:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecialValue(params)
    
    if params.ability == self:GetAbility() then
        local specialValue = params.ability_special_value
        local im_level = GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty()
        if specialValue == "necromastery_max_souls" then
            local flBaseValue = params.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueNoOverride(specialValue, params.ability_special_level)
            local totalValue = flBaseValue + 15 + self.heroCounts
            if im_level > 0 then
                totalValue = totalValue + 20
            end
            if im_level > 1 then
                totalValue = totalValue + 45
            end
            return totalValue
        end
    end

    local sound_name = "Hero_Nevermore.RequiemOfSoulsCast"

    ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(self.pfx_wings, 0, cast_pos)
    return true
end

function phantom_assassin_phantom_strike:OnSpellStart()
	-- unit identifier
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	local target = self:GetCursorTarget()
	local origin = caster:GetOrigin()

	-- Stop if blocked by linken
	if target:GetTeamNumber()~=caster:GetTeamNumber() then
		if target:TriggerSpellAbsorb( self ) then
			return
		end
	end

	-- Get data
	local buff_duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")


	-- Generate data
	local blinkDistance = 50
	local blinkDirection = (caster:GetOrigin() - target:GetOrigin()):Normalized() * blinkDistance
	local blinkPosition = target:GetOrigin() + blinkDirection

	-- Blink
	caster:SetOrigin( blinkPosition )
	FindClearSpaceForUnit( caster, blinkPosition, true )

	-- Add modifier
	if target:GetTeamNumber()~=caster:GetTeamNumber() then
		caster:AddNewModifier(
			caster, -- player source
			self, -- ability source
			"m_modifier_phantom_assassin_phantom_strike", -- modifier name
			{ duration = buff_duration } -- kv
		)
		caster:MoveToTargetToAttack(target)

		if self:add_bingo() then
			caster:AddNewModifier(
				caster,
				self,
				"modifier_phantom_assassin_mark_of_death",
				{ duration = 5 }
			)
		end
	end

	self:PlayEffects( origin )
end

    if params.ability:GetName() == "phoenix_supernova" then
        local specialValue = params.ability_special_value
        local im_level = GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty()
        local flBaseValue = params.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueNoOverride(specialValue, params.ability_special_level)
         if specialValue == "max_hero_attacks" then
            local totalValue = flBaseValue
            if im_level >= 2 then
                totalValue = totalValue +10
            end
            return totalValue
        end
        if specialValue == "max_hero_attacks_scepter" then
            local level = params.ability:GetLevel()
            flBaseValue = params.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueNoOverride(specialValue, level - 1)
            local totalValue = flBaseValue
            if im_level >= 2 then
                totalValue = totalValue +10
            end
            return totalValue
        end

            local totalValue = flBaseValue

            end
            if im_level >= 2 then

            end

        end
        if specialValue == "AbilityCooldown" then

            end

        end
    end

-- Ability Start
function pudge_meat_hook:OnSpellStart()
	-- unit identifier
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	local point = self:GetCursorPosition()

	-- load data
	local projectile_name = ""
	local projectile_distance = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "AbilityCastRange" )
	local projectile_speed = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "hook_speed" )
	local projectile_radius = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "hook_width" )
	-- calculate direction
	local origin = caster:GetOrigin()
	local dir = point - origin
	dir.z = 0
	local projectile_direction = dir:Normalized()

	-- calculate target
	local target = origin + projectile_direction * projectile_distance

	-- create projectiles
	local info = {
		Source = caster,
		Ability = self,
		vSpawnOrigin = caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
	
		bDeleteOnHit = true,
	
		iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_BOTH,
		iUnitTargetFlags = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
		iUnitTargetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
	
		EffectName = projectile_name,
		fDistance = projectile_distance,
		fStartRadius = projectile_radius,
		fEndRadius = projectile_radius,
		vVelocity = projectile_direction * projectile_speed,
	}
	local id = ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(info)

	-- create projectile data
	local data = {}
	data.cast_location = origin
	self.projectiles[id] = data

	-- play effects
	self:PlayEffects( target, data )
end

-- Projectile
pudge_meat_hook.projectiles = {}
function pudge_meat_hook:OnProjectileHitHandle( target, location, handle )
	local data = self.projectiles[handle]
	if not data then return true end

	if not target then
		-- remove ref
		self.projectiles[handle] = nil

		-- set effects
		self:SetEffects1( data )

		return true
	end

	if target==self:GetCaster() then
		-- pass
		return false
	end
	if target:GetName() == "npc_dota_roshan" then
		-- pass
		return false
	end

	-- add drag modifier
	target:AddNewModifier(
		self:GetCaster(), -- player source
		self, -- ability source
		"modifier_pudge_meat_hook_lua", -- modifier name
		{ handle = handle } -- kv
	)

	-- damage
	if target:GetTeamNumber()~=self:GetCaster():GetTeamNumber() then
		local damage = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "damage" )
		local damageTable = {
			victim = target,
			attacker = self:GetCaster(),
			damage = damage,
			damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
			ability = self, --Optional.
		}
		ApplyDamage(damageTable)

		if target:IsCreep() and not target:IsCreepHero() and not target:IsAncient() then
			target:Kill( self, self:GetCaster() )
		end
	elseif self:GetCaster():HasShard() then
		--魔晶钩队友cd减半
		local level = self:GetLevel()
		local actual_cd = self:GetEffectiveCooldown(level - 1)
		self:ModifyCooldown(-actual_cd/2)
	end

	-- add FOW
	local radius = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "vision_radius" )
	local duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "vision_duration" )
	AddFOWViewer( self:GetCaster():GetTeamNumber(), target:GetOrigin(), radius, duration, false )

	-- set effects
	self:SetEffects2( data, target )

	return true
end

-- Effects
function pudge_meat_hook:PlayEffects( point, data )
	-- Get Resources
	local particle_cast = "particles/units/heroes/hero_pudge/pudge_meathook.vpcf"
	local sound_cast = "Hero_Pudge.AttackHookExtend"

	-- Get Data
	local speed = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "hook_speed" )
	local distance = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "AbilityCastRange" )
	local radius = self:GetSpecialValueFor( "hook_width" )
	local duration = distance/speed * 2.2
	local caster_origin = self:GetCaster():GetAbsOrigin()
	self.caster_origin = caster_origin

	local effect_cast = ParticleManager:CreateParticle( particle_cast, PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, nil)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(	effect_cast, 0,	caster_origin)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 1, point )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 2, Vector( speed, distance, radius ) )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 3, Vector( duration, 0, 0 ) )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 4, Vector( 1, 0, 0 ) )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( effect_cast, 5, Vector( 0, 0, 0 ) )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(	effect_cast, 7,	caster_origin)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleAlwaysSimulate( effect_cast )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleShouldCheckFoW( effect_cast, false )
	
	-- Create Sound
	EmitSoundOn( sound_cast, self:GetCaster() )

	-- store effect
	data.effect_cast = effect_cast
end

function pudge_meat_hook:SetEffects1( data )
	-- set return effect
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( data.effect_cast, 1, self.caster_origin )
	ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex( data.effect_cast )

	EmitSoundOn( "Hero_Pudge.AttackHookRetract", self:GetCaster() )
end

function pudge_meat_hook:SetEffects2( data, target )
	-- set effects
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(
		data.effect_cast,
		1,
		target,
		PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW,
		"attach_hitloc",
		Vector(0,0,0), -- unknown
		true -- unknown, true
	)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( data.effect_cast, 4, Vector( 0, 0, 0 ) )
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl( data.effect_cast, 5, Vector( 1, 0, 0 ) )

	EmitSoundOn( "Hero_Pudge.AttackHookImpact", target )
	EmitSoundOn( "Hero_Pudge.AttackHookRetract", self:GetCaster() )
end

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot = class({})
function skywrath_mage_concussive_shot:GetAbilityTextureName()
   return "skywrath_mage_concussive_shot"
end

function skywrath_mage_concussive_shot:OnSpellStart()
    -- Ability properties
    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local ability = self
    local sound_cast = "Hero_SkywrathMage.ConcussiveShot.Cast"    
    local particle_fail = "particles/units/heroes/hero_skywrath_mage/skywrath_mage_concussive_shot_failure.vpcf"    
    local scepter = caster:HasScepter()

    -- Ability specials
    local launch_radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("launch_radius")
    local scepter_radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("scepter_radius")
    if caster:HasTalent("special_bonus_unique_skywrath_4") then
        launch_radius = 99999
        scepter_radius = 99999
    end

    -- Play cast sound
    EmitSoundOn(sound_cast, caster)

    -- Find the closest valid enemy to shot the projectile on
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(caster:GetTeamNumber(),
                                      caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
                                      nil,
                                      launch_radius,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NOT_ILLUSIONS,
                                      FIND_CLOSEST,
                                      false)

    -- If no enemies was found, add fizzle effect and exit
    if #enemies == 0 then
        local particle_fail_fx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particle_fail, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN, caster)
        ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle_fail_fx, 0, caster:GetAbsOrigin())
        ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle_fail_fx, 1, caster:GetAbsOrigin())
        ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(particle_fail_fx)

        return nil
    else
        for enemy = 1 , #enemies do
            self:FireConcussiveShot(enemies[enemy])
        end
    end

    -- Fire projectile

    -- Scepter: fire another Concussive Shot at a random enemy. Prioritizes enemies/illusions.
    if scepter then
        local scepter_target = SkywrathSpellsTargetFinder(caster, enemies[1], scepter_radius)
        if scepter_target then
            self:FireConcussiveShot(scepter_target)
        end         
    end
end

function SkywrathSpellsTargetFinder(caster, target, radius)    

    -- Find heroes around the target
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(caster:GetTeamNumber(),
                                      target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                                      nil,
                                      radius,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NOT_CREEP_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS,
                                      FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                      false)

    -- Cycle for a target that is not the initial target    
    for _,enemy in pairs(enemies) do

        -- If a valid hero target was found, return it
        if enemy ~= target then          
            return enemy
        end
    end    

    -- If this check failed, check for creeps/creep heroes instead
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(caster:GetTeamNumber(),
                                      target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                                      nil,
                                      radius,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS,
                                      FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                      false)

    -- Cycle for a target that is not the initial target
    for _,enemy in pairs(enemies) do
      
        -- If a valid creep target was found, return it
        if enemy ~= target then
            return enemy
        end
    end    

    -- Otherwise, return nothing
    return nil
end

function skywrath_mage_concussive_shot:FireConcussiveShot(target)    
    -- Ability properties
    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local ability = self
    local particle_projectile = "particles/units/heroes/hero_skywrath_mage/skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.vpcf"

    -- Ability specials    
    local speed = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("speed")
    local shot_vision = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("shot_vision")    

    -- Define and launch projectile
    local concussive_projectile
    concussive_projectile = {Target = target,
                              Source = caster,
                              Ability = ability,
                              EffectName = particle_projectile,
                              iMoveSpeed = speed,
                              bDodgeable = true, 
                              bVisibleToEnemies = true,
                              bReplaceExisting = false,
                              bProvidesVision = true,
                              iVisionRadius = shot_vision,
                              iVisionTeamNumber = caster:GetTeamNumber()                            
                            }

    ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(concussive_projectile)  
end


function skywrath_mage_concussive_shot:OnProjectileHit(target, location)    
    -- If there was no target, do nothing
    if not target then
        return nil
    end

    -- Ability properties
    local caster = self:GetCaster()
    local ability = self
    local sound_impact = "Hero_SkywrathMage.ConcussiveShot.Target"    
    local modifier_slow = "modifier_skywrath_mage_concussive_shot_slow"

    -- Ability specials
    local slow_radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("slow_radius")
    local damage = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("damage")
    local slow_duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("slow_duration")
    local shot_vision = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("shot_vision")
    local vision_duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("vision_duration")

    -- Add FOW Viewer
    AddFOWViewer(caster:GetTeamNumber(),
                 location,
                 shot_vision,
                 vision_duration,
                 false)    

    -- Play impact sound
    EmitSoundOn(sound_impact, caster)

    -- Find enemies around the impact area
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(caster:GetTeamNumber(),
                                      target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                                      nil,
                                      slow_radius,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                      DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                      FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                      false)
    
    -- For each enemy, only apply if the enemy is not magic immune
    for _,enemy in pairs(enemies) do
        if not enemy:IsMagicImmune() then
            if not enemy:IsHero() then 
                damage = damage * 0.75 
            end
            -- Deal damage
            local damageTable = {victim = enemy,
                                 attacker = caster, 
                                 damage = damage,
                                 damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
                                 ability = ability
                                 }
        
            ApplyDamage(damageTable)  

            -- Apply/Refresh slow debuff
            enemy:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, modifier_slow, {duration = slow_duration})
        end
    end  
end

        local specialValue = params.ability_special_value
        if specialValue == "stat_loss" or specialValue == "agi_gain"  then
            return 1
        end

function modifier_slark_essence_shift_awakening:GetModifierOverrideAbilitySpecialValue(params)
    if params.ability:GetName() == "slark_essence_shift" then
        local specialValue = params.ability_special_value
        local im_level = GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty()
        if  specialValue == "stat_loss" or specialValue == "agi_gain" then
            local flBaseValue = params.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueNoOverride(specialValue, params.ability_special_level)
            local totalValue = flBaseValue
            if im_level >= 2 then
                totalValue = totalValue * 3
            end
            return totalValue
        end
    end

    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent:IsAlive() then return end
    if not parent:FindAbilityByName("slark_essence_shift") then return end
    local skl = parent:FindAbilityByName("slark_essence_shift")
    if not params.unit:IsRealHero() then return end
    if params.unit:GetTeam() == parent:GetTeam() then return end
    local dis = CalcDistanceBetweenEntityOBB(params.unit,parent)
    if dis >= 1800 then return end
    if GameRules:GetCustomGameDifficulty() >= 0 then
        local bff = parent:FindModifierByName("modifier_slark_essence_shift_permanent_buff")
        if bff then
            bff:SetStackCount(bff:GetStackCount()+1)

            bff = parent:FindModifierByName("modifier_slark_essence_shift_permanent_buff")
            bff:SetStackCount(bff:GetStackCount()+1)

-- Motion Effects
function modifier_storm_spirit_ball_lightning_lua:UpdateHorizontalMotion( me, dt )
	-- movement
	local origin = me:GetOrigin()
	local direction = self.center - origin --距离施法点还有多少距离
	local distance = direction:Length2D()  --距离目标的距离 
	direction.z = 0
	direction = direction:Normalized() --方向矢量矢量

	local target = origin + direction*self.speed*dt
	me:SetOrigin( target )

	-- damage
	local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
		self.team,	-- int, your team number
		origin,	-- point, center point
		nil,	-- handle, cacheUnit. (not known)
		self.radius,	-- float, radius. or use FIND_UNITS_EVERYWHERE
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,	-- int, team filter
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,	-- int, type filter
		0,	-- int, flag filter
		0,	-- int, order filter
		false	-- bool, can grow cache
	)
	for _,enemy in pairs(enemies) do
		if not self.enemies[enemy] then
			-- only hit a unit once
			self.enemies[enemy] = true

			-- damage
			self.damageTable.victim = enemy
			self.damageTable.damage = self.travel_total/self.tick * self.damage
			ApplyDamage( self.damageTable )
		end
	end

	-- destroy trees
	GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint( me:GetOrigin(), self.tree, false )

	-- view

	-- reached distance

        if self.distance_traveled_since_last_remnant >= self.remnant_spawn_distance then

           local remnant_ability = self.parent:FindAbilityByName(self.remnant_ability_name)
            if remnant_ability then

            end
            self.distance_traveled_since_last_remnant = 0 -- 重置距离计数
        end

	-- check mana and damage for every self.tick units
	local travel = (self.origin - me:GetOrigin()):Length2D()
	if travel - self.travel_total<self.tick then return end
	self.travel_total = self.travel_total + self.tick

	-- check mana
	local mana = self:GetParent():GetMana()
	local maxmana = self:GetParent():GetMaxMana()
	local manacost = self.mana_flat + maxmana*self.mana_pct

		self:Destroy()
		return
	end

	-- spend mana

function modifier_techies_land_mines_lua:OnCreated(kv)
    self.ability = self:GetAbility()
    self.radius = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
    self.activation_delay = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("activation_delay")
    self.building_damage_pct = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("building_damage_pct")
    self.damage = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("damage")
    self.burn_duration = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("burn_duration")
    self.activated = false

    local interval = 0.1
    self.caster = self:GetCaster()
    self.target = self:GetParent()
    self.team_id = self.caster:GetTeamNumber()

    self.super = false

    if IsServer() then
        self.damageTable = {
