            damage_type = self.ability:GetAbilityDamageType(),
            ability = self.ability, --Optional.
        }
        self:StartIntervalThink(interval)
    end
end

function modifier_techies_land_mines_lua:OnRefresh(kv)

end

function modifier_techies_land_mines_lua:OnDestroy(kv)
    if not IsServer() then
        return
    end

    local target = self.target
    if not self.activated then
        return
    end

    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        self.team_id,                                                                   -- int, your team number
        target:GetOrigin(),                                                             -- point, center point
        nil,                                                                            -- handle, cacheUnit. (not known)
        self.radius,                                                                    -- float, radius. or use FIND_UNITS_EVERYWHERE
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,                                                    -- int, team filter DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_CREEP + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BUILDING,     -- int, type filter
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,                                     -- int, flag filter
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,                                                                 -- int, order filter
        false                                                                           -- bool, can grow cache
    )


    local pos1 = target:GetAbsOrigin()
    for _, enemy in pairs(enemies) do
        self.damageTable.victim = enemy
        self.damageTable.damage = self.damage
        if enemy:IsBuilding() then
            self.damageTable.damage = self.damage * self.building_damage_pct / 100
        end
        local distance = (pos1 - enemy:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()
        if distance > 150 then
            self.damageTable.damage = self.damageTable.damage / 2
        end

        if self.super then
            -- 如果是超级地雷，伤害翻倍
            self.damageTable.damage = self.damageTable.damage * 1.15
        end

        ApplyDamage(self.damageTable)

        -- 挂一个 减魔抗的modifier
        if not enemy:IsBuilding() then
            enemy:AddNewModifier(
                self.caster, self.ability,
                "modifier_techies_land_mine_burn",
                { duration = self.burn_duration }
            )
        end
    end
    self:PlayEffects()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Interval Effects
function modifier_techies_land_mines_lua:OnIntervalThink()
    local target = self.target

    if target:HasModifier("modifier_techies_minefield_sign_aura") then
        self.super = true
    else
        self.super = false
    end

    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        self.team_id,                                                                    -- int, your team number
        target:GetOrigin(),                                                              -- point, center point
        nil,                                                                             -- handle, cacheUnit. (not known)
        self.radius,                                                                     -- float, radius. or use FIND_UNITS_EVERYWHERE

        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,                                      -- int, flag filter
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,                                                                  -- int, order filter
        false                                                                            -- bool, can grow cache
    )

    if #enemies ~= 0 then
        -- 再次搜寻到敌人，就爆炸
        if self.activated then
            self:GetParent():ForceKill(false)
        else
            self.activated = true
            self:StartIntervalThink(self.activation_delay)
        end
    else
        if self.activated then
            self.activated = false
            self:StartIntervalThink(0.1)
        end
    end
end

    local state = {
        [MODIFIER_STATE_INVISIBLE] = true,

        [MODIFIER_STATE_NO_UNIT_COLLISION] = self.super,

    return state
end

function m_modifier_tusk_walrus_punch_air_time:UpdateVerticalMotion(hParent, dt)
    if IsServer() then
        if not hParent:IsAlive() and self.fHeight == 650 then
            self.vStart = hParent:GetAbsOrigin()
            self.fHeight = 1200
            self.fHeightOffset = GetGroundHeight(self.vStart, hParent) - self.vStart.z
            self.vAcceleration = -self.vUpVector * 8 * self.fHeight / self:GetDuration() ^ 2
            self.vStartVerticalVelocity = Vector(0, 0, self.fHeightOffset) / self:GetDuration() -
                self.vAcceleration * self:GetDuration() / 2
        end
        hParent:SetAbsOrigin(self.vStart + self.vStartVerticalVelocity * self:GetElapsedTime() +
            0.5 * self.vAcceleration * self:GetElapsedTime() ^ 2)
        local fPercent = 1 - self:GetElapsedTime() / self:GetDuration()
        local qAngles = hParent:GetLocalAngles()
        hParent:SetLocalAngles(RemapValClamped(fPercent, 0, 1, 0, 360), qAngles[2], qAngles[3])
    end
end

modifier_wisp_tether_lua = class({})

function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:IsHidden() return false end
function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:IsPurgable() return false end
function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:GetPriority() return MODIFIER_PRIORITY_SUPER_ULTRA end

function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:OnCreated(params)
	self.parent         = self:GetParent() --必定为这个modifier的挂载者
	self.target         = self:GetCaster() --为入参的第一个 在这里等于target 
	self.original_speed = self.parent:GetMoveSpeedModifier(self.parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed(), false)
	self.target_speed   = self.target:GetMoveSpeedModifier(self.target:GetBaseMoveSpeed(), true)
	self.difference     = self.target_speed - self.original_speed
	self.heal           = 0
	self.mana           = 0
	self.ability = self:GetAbility()

	self.team = self.parent:GetTeamNumber()

	
	self.unit_damage = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("tethered_unit_damage") or 0
	self.speed_slow = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("slow") or 0
	self.damage = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("damage") or 0

	-- print("======两者速度初始",self.original_speed,self.target_speed,self.difference,IsServer())
	self:StartIntervalThink(0.5)
	self.ds_flag = false

	if not IsServer() then
		return 
	end
	self.tether_heal_amp = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("tether_heal_amp") / 100
	self.radius = self.ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
	self.target:EmitSound("Hero_Wisp.Tether")

end

function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:OnIntervalThink()
	self.difference     = 0
	self.original_speed = self.parent:GetMoveSpeedModifier(self.parent:GetBaseMoveSpeed(), false)
	self.target_speed   = self.target:GetMoveSpeedModifier(self.target:GetBaseMoveSpeed(), true)
	self.difference     = math.max(self.target_speed,320) - self.original_speed

	if not IsServer() then return end

	SendOverheadEventMessage(self.target, OVERHEAD_ALERT_HEAL, self.target, self.heal * self.tether_heal_amp, nil)
	self.target:Heal(self.heal * self.tether_heal_amp, self.ability)
	self.heal = 0
	SendOverheadEventMessage(self.target, OVERHEAD_ALERT_MANA_ADD, self.target, self.mana * self.tether_heal_amp,nil)
	self.target:GiveMana(self.mana * self.tether_heal_amp)
	self.mana = 0


	--魔晶效果 damage_to_heal  damage slow
	-- 碰撞减速 碰撞伤害 伤害回复  120 / 2  魔法伤害 
	local st_pos = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
	local end_pos = self.target:GetAbsOrigin()
	local units = FindUnitsInLine(self.team, st_pos, end_pos, nil, 100, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_ALL, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE)

	-- 预定义常量
	local damage_amount = self.damage * 0.5
	local caster = self.parent
	local ability = self.ability

	-- 准备伤害表 (放在循环外只建一次表，稍微优化性能)
	local damage_table = {
		attacker = caster,
		damage = damage_amount,
		damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL, -- 伤害类型：魔法
		ability = self.ability
	}

	for _, unit in pairs(units) do
		if IsValid(unit) and unit:IsAlive() then
			unit:AddNewModifier(
				caster,                -- 来源
				ability,               -- 来源技能
				"modifier_wisp_tether_lua_slow", -- Modifier 名称 (上面定义的那个)
				{ duration = 0.2 }
			)

			if damage_amount > 0 then
				damage_table.victim = unit -- 更新当前目标
				local actual_damage = ApplyDamage(damage_table)
				local heal_amount = actual_damage * 0.5
				caster:Heal(heal_amount, ability)
				SendOverheadEventMessage(caster, OVERHEAD_ALERT_HEAL, caster, heal_amount, nil)
			end
			-- (可选) 如果想让回血特效更明显，可以加粒子特效
			-- local particle = ParticleManager:CreateParticle("particles/units/heroes/hero_wisp/wisp_overcharge_buff.vpcf",
			-- 	PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, caster)
			-- ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(particle)
		end
	end

	-- 过载相关
	local overcharge = self.parent:FindModifierByName("modifier_wisp_overcharge")
	local to_over = self.target:FindModifierByName("modifier_wisp_overcharge")
	if overcharge then
		if not to_over then
			local ability = overcharge:GetAbility()
			self.target:AddNewModifier(self.parent, ability, "modifier_wisp_overcharge", {})
		end
	else
		if to_over then
			to_over:Destroy()
		end
	end

	--计算距离 如果超出范围就扯断 
	local distance = (self.target:GetOrigin() - self.parent:GetOrigin()):Length2D()
	-- local juli2 = (self.target:GetAbsOrigin() - self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()
	-- print("====目前的距离差",distance,self.radius)
	if distance > self.radius then
		if self.ds_flag then
			self:Destroy()
		else
			self.ds_flag = true
		end
	else
		self.ds_flag = false
	end
	
end

function modifier_wisp_tether_lua:DeclareFunctions()
	local decFuncs = {
		MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_HEAL_RECEIVED,
		MODIFIER_EVENT_ON_MANA_GAINED,
		MODIFIER_PROPERTY_MOVESPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT,
		MODIFIER_PROPERTY_IGNORE_MOVESPEED_LIMIT,
		MODIFIER_PROPERTY_DISABLE_HEALING,
		MODIFIER_PROPERTY_PREATTACK_BONUS_DAMAGE,       -- 绿字攻击力
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_PHYSICAL_ARMOR_BONUS,         -- 护甲

	if IsServer() then

		self.destroy_tree_radius  = params.destroy_tree_radius
		self.final_latch_distance = 300
		self.latch_speed =  self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("latch_speed") * FrameTime()
		self:StartIntervalThink(FrameTime())
	end

function modifier_wisp_tether_lua_latch:OnIntervalThink()
	if IsServer() then

		if self:GetParent():IsStunned() or self:GetParent():IsHexed() or self:GetParent():IsOutOfGame() or (self:GetParent().IsFeared and self:GetParent():IsFeared()) or (self:GetParent().IsHypnotized and self:GetParent():IsHypnotized()) or self:GetParent():IsRooted() then
			self:StartIntervalThink(-1)
			-- print("=====移除了")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local casterDir = self:GetCaster():GetAbsOrigin() - self.target:GetAbsOrigin()
		local distToAlly = casterDir:Length2D()
		casterDir = casterDir:Normalized()
		if distToAlly > self.final_latch_distance then
			distToAlly = distToAlly - self.latch_speed
			distToAlly = math.max(distToAlly, self.final_latch_distance) -- Clamp this value
			local pos = self.target:GetAbsOrigin() + casterDir * distToAlly
			pos = GetGroundPosition(pos, self:GetCaster())
			self:GetCaster():SetAbsOrigin(pos)
			-- print("====移动中",distToAlly)
		else
			GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint(self:GetCaster():GetAbsOrigin(),128, false)

			-- 	FindClearSpaceForUnit(modifier.target, pos, true)
			-- print("=====距离够了 移除了")
			self:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if not IsServer() then return end
	-- print("==== 不合法 强制修改 ")
	FindClearSpaceForUnit(self:GetParent(), self:GetParent():GetAbsOrigin(), true)

function modifier_death_ward:OnIntervalThink()
	if not IsServer() then
		return
	end
	local parent = self:GetParent()

	if self:IsInChronosphere() then
		self:StopAttacking(parent) -- Don't allow Death Ward to attack anything while inside Chronosphere
		return
	end

	local target = parent:GetForceAttackTarget()
	local aggro = parent:GetAggroTarget()
	local real_target = parent:GetAttackTarget()

	if target then
		parent:SetForceAttackTarget(nil) -- units with force attack target ignore orders so we remove that
		-- We remove force-to-attack-target but the ward should still have aggro over the target and still attack it in the next loop
		return
	end

	if aggro then
		if aggro:IsConsideredHero() then
			-- If aggro is on the hero-like unit, no need to continue (looking for hero-like units, force changing aggro)
			return
		end
	end

	if real_target and real_target.IsConsideredHero then
		if not real_target:IsConsideredHero() then
			-- If real_target is not the hero-like unit, stop attacking
			self:StopAttacking(parent)
			return
		end
	end

	local ability = self:GetAbility()
	local targets_flags = bit.bor(DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NOT_ATTACK_IMMUNE,
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_FOW_VISIBLE)
	-- Find nearest target and attack it
	local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(parent:GetTeamNumber(), parent:GetAbsOrigin(), nil, parent:GetAttackRange(),
		DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, ability:GetAbilityTargetType(), targets_flags, FIND_CLOSEST, false)
	parent:SetIdleAcquire(true)
	parent:SetAcquisitionRange(parent:GetAttackRange())
	if #enemies > 0 then
		parent:SetForceAttackTarget(enemies[1])
		parent:SetAggroTarget(enemies[1]) -- neat trick of forcing the aggro on the hero-like unit
		-- else
		-- 	self:StopAttacking(parent)
	else
		local basic_enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(parent:GetTeamNumber(), parent:GetAbsOrigin(), nil,
			parent:GetAttackRange(),
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY, DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC, targets_flags, FIND_CLOSEST, false)
		if #basic_enemies > 0 then
			parent:SetForceAttackTarget(basic_enemies[1])
			parent:SetAggroTarget(basic_enemies[1])
		end
	end
end
